title: Enterprise Agentic AI, Hybrid RAG, Clean-Core MCP & LLM Evaluation Reference Implementations
description: Open-source engineering reference implementations and technical field guides covering hybrid retrieval (Vecta), agent runtime policy and audit (AegisRuntime), multi-tenant LLM gateways (PrismGate), grammar-constrained decoding (Syntara), Clean-Core OData MCP servers, and statistical evaluation (Calibra).
